reviewer: root, independent of the proof author
scope: Geometric filtration, deepest space and generic Chow specialization from the original geometric hypotheses.

audit_groups.finding: Only nef-and-big B times nonnegative powers of the generated L is used for residue surjectivity. Division uses nef-and-big A times powers n-i>=0, with n>=D. No unjustified negative twist of A is treated as nef.

The regular sequence gives a free monomial basis in I^a/I^(a+1). After the induction at degree j+1, vanishing of the symbol forces every coefficient to vanish at Z. First-order Koszul division then gives the next power, without a resolution or a vanishing hypothesis for ideal powers.

V_0=G_0 and only degrees through T are required. The non-global V_D remains in P_s. For W_s=G_T+P_s the deepest space is exactly P_s; no identification of V_D or V_T with all global sections is assumed.

Multiplication by e is invertible on the finite etale Z. Adjunction and etale duality give the original residue coordinates. One K-rational linear form avoids all split points, and its products with the onto degree-zero residues supply every graded symbol.

A finite etale fibre of the existing projection avoids the proper closed image of the excluded locus. Properness and the relative Jacobian give a nonempty principal open of good tuples over K. Distinct image points, incidence and total degree delta force the exact product of linear factors.

This supplies the geometric filtration in the already reviewed determinant degree theorem. Arithmetic model, metrics, multiplication and short integral families, and the geometric height identity remain separate application data.

projective_spaces.scope: Exact monomial section spaces on P^D, D=1..4; these models have delta=1.

multipoint_projective_lines.scope: Exact polynomial spaces on P^1 with L=O(2) or O(3), including all local derivative symbols and deepest kernels.

negative_controls.example: Elliptic curve y^2=x^3-x; L=O(2 infinity), B=O, A=L, e=1, s=x-2.
negative_controls.scope: The matrix and the two distinct curve points are checked exactly; standard section-basis facts are explained in the mathematical note.

limits: The exact finite models check selected algebraic cases; the written proof supplies the general theorem.
No arithmetic compactification, integral metric identity or short-section family is constructed here.
No Lean build or whole-node completion is claimed.
